description: Shows what is set up in Agent to Agent Testing. Without a project: the account's projects with their type and suite and scenario counts, filtered by type or name, plus a count of projects per type. With a project: its chat agents, its suites with scenario counts, and, for chat and voice, its endpoint profiles (the saved connections to the agent under test) by name, saying which is the default; for an image analyser project, its configured checks. A scenario is one test conversation; a suite is a group of scenarios run together. Endpoint URLs, headers, credentials and phone numbers are never returned. Projects, suites, scenarios and endpoint profiles cannot be created, edited or deleted with these tools; that is done in the product UI. Covers chat, voice, phone caller (including IVR) and image analyser projects.

project.description: Project name (all or part of it) or ID. Omit to list the projects.

query.description: When listing projects: only those whose name contains this.

sort.description: When listing projects: the order of the rows.

type.description: When listing projects: only this project type, for example chat, voice or image_analyzer.
